baseline: B_std^Weil6; standard exact exterior algebra, Hermitian arithmetic and derived deformation theory

missing_object.missing_object: An actual Z0 in CH^3(A_J)_Q on the frozen very-general [-3] family with P_Weil([1+2i]^*) cl(Z0) != 0.
missing_object.necessity: An algebraic projector preserves algebraicity but cannot produce a nonzero seed from zero or divisor-only classes.
missing_object.unblock_condition: Give an independently constructed cycle, sheaf characteristic class, or algebraic correspondence and verify its nonzero Weil projection on the SAME fixed frontier model.

input: arbitrary w=a r+b s with a,b rational, including zero, signs, denominators

algebraic_projector.construction: P(x)=g(x) times inverse(g mod q), where q is the Weil factor and g the product of the other factors. P=1 mod q, P=0 mod g.
algebraic_projector.reason_algebraic: Each T^j is pullback by an actual finite algebraic endomorphism [ (1+2i)^j ]; rational linear combinations act on rational algebraic cycles. No unproved algebraic Hodge projector is assumed.

conditional_lift.precondition: An actual cycle Z0 whose projected class v=P(T)cl(Z0)=a r+b s is nonzero and whose rational a,b are verified
conditional_lift.step1: Z1=P(T)Z0 is an actual rational cycle, conditional on Z0.
conditional_lift.step2: Use Z1 and T Z1. Their class matrix is [[a,117a+44b],[b,-44a+117b]].
conditional_lift.step3: Solve the exact rational 2x2 system for the requested w; apply the same coefficients to Z1,T Z1.
conditional_lift.tests_are: Purely conditional rational linear algebra, not observed cycle examples.

divisor_negative_control: At the very-general fiber NS_Q=Q theta; theta^3 has T-eigenvalue 125 and P(125)=0. Divisor-only generators cannot satisfy the nonzero seed precondition.

null_control.interpretation: u wedge v tensor [X,Y] is nonzero for independent invariant (0,1)-forms u,v; its semiregularity image is zero.

exact_check.finite_check_limit: Finite matrices and polynomial identities only. The infinite norm-parity proof, period-domain existence, and generic divisor input are stated/proven or attributed separately. No checker assertion certifies an open cycle-existence statement.

attribution: Standard algebraic endomorphism projector and exact linear algebra. It compresses the missing object to one nonzero exceptional algebraic seed but earns no Enterprise-specific novelty credit.
